versions.subject: fix: add missing selection
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\jpsetup.exe'
        - '\jpinst.exe'
filter_main_cli_name:
    CommandLine:
        - 'jpinst.exe'
        - 'jpinst'
        - 'jpsetup.exe'
        - 'jpsetup'
filter_main_cli_empty:
    CommandLine: ''
filter_main_cli_null:
    CommandLine: null
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\jpsetup.exe", "*\\jpinst.exe") NOT (CommandLine IN ("jpinst.exe", "jpinst", "jpsetup.exe", "jpsetup") OR CommandLine="" OR NOT CommandLine=*)
